name: Squeeze
shape: The range at its quietest in months, by the stock's own standard.
description: Not a shape and not a direction. This measures how wide the stock's range is against its own recent history and lists the names sitting in the quietest part of it. The common claim that a squeeze must resolve one way or the other is not something this can see and not something it says — it reports that a stock has stopped moving, which is a fact about the range. The level shown is the ceiling of the quiet stretch, because that is what a move out of it would clear. This shape has never been tested on this site. The out-of-sample study behind the base screens found no measurable edge in their structural parts — only in relative strength — and no equivalent study has been run against trendline shapes at all. Read this screen as a description of what the chart is doing, which is checkable, and not as a reason to expect anything.

concepts.title: Bandwidth
concepts.text: The width of the range, against its own history.

concepts.title: The quiet stretch
concepts.text: How long it has been this still.

funnel.title: The liquid US universe
funnel.text: US common stocks over $5, market cap over $300M, and at least $5M traded a day over the last 20 sessions.

funnel.title: The measurement window
funnel.text: Both bands are computed over 20 sessions.

funnel.title: Inside the channel
funnel.text: The bands sit entirely inside 1.5 average true ranges.

funnel.title: Long enough to be a squeeze
funnel.text: The bands have been inside the channel for 5 sessions.

funnel.title: Leadership
funnel.text: Relative strength rating of 70 or better.

funnel_preface: Every number below is a dial you can move in Filters.

params.label: Periods in the bands
params.funnel_text: Both bands are computed over {value} sessions.
params.help: Bollinger bands and the Keltner channel are both built over this many sessions. Twenty is the convention.

params.label: Keltner width, in average ranges
params.funnel_text: The bands sit entirely inside {value} average true ranges.
params.help: How wide the Keltner channel is. A squeeze is a two-sigma move fitting inside this many average ranges — lower is a tighter, rarer reading.

params.label: Shortest compression we'll accept
params.funnel_title: Long enough to be a squeeze
params.funnel_text: The bands have been inside the channel for {value} sessions.
params.help: A single quiet session is not a compression. This is the run length below which it is treated as noise.

params.label: Lowest RS rating we'll accept
params.funnel_text: Relative strength rating of {value} or better.
params.help: Where the stock's 3, 6 and 12-month return ranks against every other name in the universe, 1 to 99. This is the one filter with published statistical support behind it.

params.label: How recent counts as fresh
params.help: A breakout stays in the fresh bucket for this many sessions before it moves to climbing.

trade_steps.title: Buy the breakout
trade_steps.text: As it pushes through the pivot.

trade_steps.title: Set a safety net
trade_steps.text: An automatic exit if it drops about 8% from where you got in.

trade_steps.title: Lock in "no loss"
trade_steps.text: Once it is up enough, move that net to where you started.

trade_steps.title: Ride the trend
trade_steps.text: Raise the net as it climbs.

trade_steps_preface: Risk is decided before entry — about 1.5% of capital on any one trade.
